title: Graf Porno und die liebesdurstigen Töchter
actors: Rinaldo Talamonti, Ingeborg Piontek, Marisa Alberti
plot: Garibaldus lives in his inherited castle, but he has financial problems. To solve them, he wants to marry his son to a rich girl. A well-to-do widow with six daughters is a good chance. And the son tries the girls one by one.
